mechanism.summary: Make dense Number scratch placement independent of incidental entry-stack position. Before choosing a fix, sweep a complete 4 KiB page at 16-byte spacing in a throwaway ASLR-off diagnostic, recording bank/backing/locals/op-stream addresses and used spans. Distinguish relative load/store aliasing from cache-line/page splits. Attempt 1 prefers safe, aligned, plan-owned banks reused across activations; if indirection/per-entry work outweighs the benefit, attempt 2 uses over-aligned stack placement. A relative placement policy must derive from storage/access geometry, not an observed absolute offset. Measure per-entry N/2N cost and verify hot executor/callee offsets by nm. Do not re-pin unless the screen proves it necessary, then isolate that commit.
mechanism.generality: Applies to bounded dense Number register programs admitted by operations, numeric types and storage/authority guards. No workload name, iteration count, source or bytecode template recognition; no hard-coded 0xdb0 policy. Slot locals/shared upvalue cells and guarded deoptimization/publication remain unchanged.
semantic_risks: Reusable banks must not expose stale registers or locals, or leak across plans/activations
Every entry, decline, guard failure, replay and completion must return any bank lease; reentry must be safe
Preserve Number IEEE behavior including NaN, signed zero and rounding, array holes, receiver aliases and exotic bailouts
Keep register and local-bank effects distinct; log actual used spans and opcode-stream geometry
The diagnostic logger changes layout; timings from it do not promote production code

Success requires a 40-run varied-padding production distribution whose range/median is at least halved versus the matched base, with median moving toward the observed fast band; report all runs and fixed-work instructions
Both cycles and instructions are controls: no cycle median above 1.03, and instruction growth must be bounded by a same-binary observed A/A floor, never assumed equal
A full-page sweep is diagnostic and not an implementation attempt; each implementation gets one screen, two attempts total
The target cannot be retained through an unstable_on_base exception; formal promotion remains separate from a screen
